answers.core: It's a feature that many of image/model manipulation tool given out of the box, and can be very useful for many cases that require rotation of specific objects around the defined pivot, especially animation.
answers.workaround: I can't really think about true solutions beside of creating a new node that will be used for rotation, and it does not work so well on partial selection. It also does not work with armature tool.

title: An ability to set a temporary "pivot" for rotating selected nodes around it in editor.
